MR COLIN LO CHOR CHEONG: Mr J C H Ho (Stipendiary Steward)
STAR BROSE: When questioned regarding his riding on the Home Turn Z Purton stated that after shifting to the outside of CAN’T GO WONG near the 500 Metres his intention was to follow GOLDEN FORTUNE, a last start winner, or alternatively follow KINGLY DEMEANOR into the race.  He said for this reason he continued to shift out with a view to obtaining clear running.  He said as he did so CAN’T GO WONG shifted out which presented a run to his inside, however, he was of the opinion his best option was to continue to follow the fancied runners into the race, particularly as the early stages had been run inside of standard time and he was concerned the leaders would commence to give ground.  He said after following GOLDEN FORTUNE from the 500 Metres that runner did not improve as he had anticipated and for this reason he shifted to its inside to follow KINGLY DEMEANOR.  He said when KINGLY DEMEANOR did not improve sufficiently in the early stages of the Home Straight to provide him with clear running this resulted in STAR BROSE being held up for clear running between the 450 Metres and the 200 Metres where he was able to improve between GOLDEN FORTUNE and KINGLY DEMEANOR.  Sent for sampling post-race.
CAN'T GO WONG: Near the 1700 Metres was eased to avoid KINGLY DEMEANOR (Apprentice H Y Yuen) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  Apprentice Yuen was advised to exercise more care.  Over the concluding stages raced tight between KINGLY DEMEANOR and PERFECT PAIRING which shifted out and as a result could not be fully tested.  When questioned K C Leung stated that he was instructed to obtain a forward position and for this reason he rode his mount along in the early stages to comply with the instructions.  He said after following CIRCUIT DUFFY during the event his intention was to endeavour to shift to the outside of CIRCUIT DUFFY and KINGLY DEMEANOR to secure clear running.  He said when GOLDEN FORTUNE maintained its position to his outside making the Home Turn this resulted in CAN’T GO WONG being unable to improve until near the 400 Metres when it shifted back to the inside of CIRCUIT DUFFY to follow I EXCELLE.  When questioned if there was an opportunity to follow I EXCELLE into the race making the Home Turn and in the early stages of the Home Straight Jockey Leung stated that he was concerned that runner would not improve into the Home Straight and he felt his best option was to follow the fancied runners GOLDEN FORTUNE and KINGLY DEMEANOR.  After considering his explanation the Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Leung were reasonable in the circumstances.
YOUNG FIGHTER: Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  When questioned L Ferraris stated that his instructions were to go forward.  He said in the early stages he rode his mount along to comply with the instructions but leaving the 1400 Metres when caught wide and to the outside of KINGLY DEMEANOR he elected to restrain his mount to obtain a position with cover.  He said his decision to do so was influenced by the fact that I EXCELLE and KINGLY DEMEANOR, which were racing in the lead, were keen and he was of the opinion he would not be able to cross those runners and also the fact that the early stages were run inside of standard time.  He added after restraining his mount to obtain cover he was able to settle behind SMART CITY near the 1100 Metres.
FIGHTING MACHINE: Apprentice P N Wong was reprimanded in relation to using her whip on a horse which was clearly out of contention.
FORTUNE KINGO: When being shifted to the outside of YOUNG FIGHTER near the 400 Metres lay in and as a result was awkwardly placed close to YOUNG FIGHTER.  Noted to have lost its right front plate after the race.
CIRCUIT DUFFY: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
YOUNG STRIKER: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
SMART CITY: On jumping was bumped by YOUNG FIGHTER which shifted in.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SPECIAL HEDGE: Near the 400 Metres was eased when disappointed for clear running between PERFECT PAIRING and CAN’T GO WONG which shifted in.  SPECIAL HEDGE was then shifted to the outside of STAR BROSE near the 200 Metres to continue into clear running and was steadied to avoid STAR BROSE when being shifted to its outside.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
TRUE BROTHERS: Near the 900 Metres was hampered when taken wider by GHORGAN.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.  Before being allowed to race again, TRUE BROTHERS will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
POSITIVE SMILE: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  M L Yeung reported that his mount finished the race off only fairly and, in his opinion, would be better suited with the reapplication of blinkers.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ISLAND HIGHFLYER: Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
LEAN GENERAL: LEAN GENERAL, which was leaning on the left side of the starting gate, jumped awkwardly and lost further ground when contacted by HEALTHY PONY which shifted in.  In the early stages raced greenly and near the 1100 Metres lay in and became unbalanced.  LEAN GENERAL continued to race greenly under pressure in the Home Straight and lay in.  Near the 250 Metres was held up for clear running when awkwardly placed close to INVICTUS.  After being shifted to the inside of CHILL PARTNERS passing the 100 Metres then raced tight to the inside of CHILL PARTNERS for a short distance thereafter.
SHANNON GLOW: Bumped near the 100 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
GHORGAN: A Atzeni reported that approaching the 900 Metres his mount commenced to race fiercely.  He said when positioned too close to the heels of INVICTUS he was obliged to shift to that runner’s outside and as a result improved into a three wide position without cover.  He added GHORGAN continued to race fiercely throughout the middle stages before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
INVICTUS: Near the 600 Metres became unbalanced when momentarily crowded between CHILL PARTNERS and GHORGAN which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.
SHOTGUN: M F Poon was reprimanded in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion near the 150 Metres.
TRENDY RUSH: Approaching the 200 Metres was shifted to the outside of SHOTGUN to continue into clear running.  Near the 100 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between PEGASUS ELITE and SHANNON GLOW, both of which shifted ground.  In this incident TRENDY RUSH made contact with SHANNON GLOW and became unbalanced.
HEALTHY PONY: Shifted in at the start and was bumped.
VICTOR SUPREME: Near the 1300 Metres, when racing keenly, shifted out and made contact with SUPREME MASTERMIND.  In the Home Straight lay in under pressure, resulting in its rider C Y Ho having to straighten his mount on a number of occasions.  Sent for sampling post-race.
DOUBLE WIN: Slow to begin.  Before being allowed to race again, DOUBLE WIN will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUGAR GOODSON: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LUCKY BALERION: Near the 200 Metres had some difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of BIG BIG WORLD.  M F Poon stated that the intention was to be more forward but when his mount jumped only fairly and lost ground it settled further back than intended.
VOLCANIC SPARK: Jumped only fairly and then made contact with LUCKY YEAR.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of VOLCANIC SPARK, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, VOLCANIC SPARK will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
ROMANTIC FANTASY: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
LUCKY YEAR: LUCKY YEAR, which was fractious in the starting gates, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to start.  Bumped on jumping.  H Bentley stated that after being forced wider from the 600 Metres, when AMAZING GAZE shifted out, his mount failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of LUCKY YEAR was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY YEAR will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
BIG BIG WORLD: M L Yeung reported that with his mount stepping up in distance it was able to hold a more forward position than its previous race starts.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUPREME MASTERMIND: Jumped only fairly.  Bumped near the 1300 Metres.  Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
KING OF SELECTION: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
GOOD GOOD: When questioned regarding the improved performance Trainer J Size stated that the horse races best when able to dictate in front without being challenged.  He said this was the reason for the horse’s improved performance today.  Sent for sampling post-race.
ON THE LASH: Trainer P C Ng confirmed the instructions were to lead the event.  Jumped awkwardly and then despite being ridden along in the early stages failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.
WATCH LEGEND: M Chadwick reported that he was instructed to take up a midfield position but his mount led the event as it was stepping up in distance.  He said, in his opinion, WATCH LEGEND would be better suited racing at Happy Valley.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CHIU CHOW GOLF: Shifted in at the start and was bumped.
CALIFORNIA WAVES: Noted to have sustained a small abrasion to the right hind leg after the race.  Sent for sampling post-race.
COMIC: On jumping was bumped by CHIU CHOW GOLF which shifted in.
MR INVINCIBLE: The tongue tie was refitted at the Start.
NOT USUAL DOUBLE: Shortly after the start was bumped by HOT AIR BALLON which shifted in.  When placed under pressure in the Home Straight raced greenly and near the 300 Metres lay in and away from DRAGON GENERATION.  Approaching the 200 Metres shifted out and as a result was steadied to avoid COOGEE BAY.  Over the final 100 Metres lay out which resulted in its rider Z Purton having to stop riding and straighten his mount approaching the finish.
DRAGON GENERATION: Jumped only fairly.  Near the 250 Metres was eased and shifted to the outside of COOGEE BAY to continue into clear running.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HOT AIR BALLON: Crowded at the start.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
LAKESHORE HERO: A Atzeni stated that from the outside barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  He said LAKESHORE HERO raced too keenly during the early and middle stage and was steadied to avoid NOT USUAL DOUBLE near the 700 Metres.  He added that as a result LAKESHORE HERO was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
REAL GENTLEMAN: Jumped awkwardly.  Bumped near the 500 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WOLF COMING: Approaching the 300 Metres improved into a narrow run to the inside of NAVAS G.  Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres was held up for clear running behind HAPPY SPECIAL.  WOLF COMING was then shifted to the outside of HAPPY SPECIAL and NAVAS G to secure clear running at the 150 Metres.  Over the final 100 Metres WOLF COMING was held up for clear running between NAVAS G and THUNDER PRINCE.
COSMO DRAGON: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 450 Metres was steadied to avoid GUTSY BRAVO (J Orman) which shifted out and away from REAL GENTLEMAN.  J Orman was advised to exercise more care.  H T Mo reported that his mount raced greenly throughout the event and in the early stages raced keenly when being steadied to obtain cover.
SHARP PLANET: Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
SMILING SKY: Over the final 100 Metres raced tight between VOYAGE CAPTAIN and THUNDER PRINCE.
VOYAGE CAPTAIN: Raced keenly throughout the early stages.  For some distance approaching the 900 Metres was checked to avoid SMILING SKY when SMILING SKY was being steadied to obtain a position with cover.  Near the 100 Metres was bumped on the hindquarters by CIRRUS SPEED which was improving to the outside of VOYAGE CAPTAIN, resulting in VOYAGE CAPTAIN becoming unbalanced.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
GUTSY BRAVO: Jumped awkwardly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
NEVER SETTLE: For some distance leaving the 1000 Metres raced tight to the inside of VOYAGE CAPTAIN.  Near the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid SMILING SKY (C L Chau) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  C L Chau was severely reprimanded.  Near the 500 Metres shifted out slightly and became unbalanced when it made contact with REAL GENTLEMAN.
NAVAS G: Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.
THUNDER PRINCE: Over the concluding stages made contact with SMILING SKY, resulting in its rider B Avdulla having to correct his mount.
CIRRUS SPEED: When questioned M F Poon stated that his instructions were to go forward and lead if possible.  He said CIRRUS SPEED jumped only fairly and shifted in, resulting in his mount losing ground at the start. He said despite riding his mount along in the early stages he was unable to hold a more forward position.  He said after following WOLF COMING in the early stages, when WOLF COMING was eased near the 900 Metres, his mount commenced to race keenly and as a result got its head up when being checked to avoid WOLF COMING.  He added throughout the middle stages CIRRUS SPEED continued to race keenly and did not settle.  He further stated that on entering the Home Straight he improved to the inside of NEVER SETTLE and had observed VOYAGE CAPTAIN improving into the event.  He said for this reason he then elected to shift to the outside of SMILING SKY to follow VOYAGE CAPTAIN into the race but when NEVER SETTLE held its position to his outside he then had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres.  He said after making contact with VOYAGE CAPTAIN near the 100 Metres his mount was then able to obtain clear running and finished the race off well.  When questioned if there was an opportunity to shift to the inside of SMILING SKY near the 300 Metres to follow THUNDER PRINCE, M F Poon stated that he had committed to the run to the outside of SMILING SKY when a run did develop between THUNDER PRINCE and SMILING SKY and as a result he was not able to take advantage of that position.  Sent for sampling post-race.
ARGENTO OCEAN: Apprentice H Y Yuen dropped her whip near the 200 Metres.  Bumped near the 100 Metres.  Apprentice Yuen stated that shortly after the start her saddle shifted back, placing her at a disadvantage throughout the event.
RUBY THRIVE: Z Purton pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 150 Metres (see SPARKLING FELLOW).
SPARKLING FELLOW: Z Purton (RUBY THRIVE) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 150 Metres he allowed his mount to shift out when not clear of SPARKLING FELLOW, resulting in SPARKLING FELLOW losing its rightful running and being checked.  Z Purton was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Sunday, 1 November 2026 at Happy Valley.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his very good race riding record.
AURORA PHOENIX: Over the final 100 Metres lay out under pressure, resulting in its rider M L Yeung having to stop riding and straighten his mount near the 50 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
ZOUPER FELLOW: Apprentice P N Wong stated that her mount was pressured throughout the race, particularly when ZETA HEDGE improved to her outside in the early stages.  She added that as a result ZOUPER FELLOW did not finish the race off over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SUNNY Q: Bumped at the start.  Near the 100 Metres made slight contact with ARGENTO OCEAN when improving to the outside of ARGENTO OCEAN.
PRECISION MIND: Jumped only fairly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, PRECISION MIND will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SUPREME VOYAGER: Jumped awkwardly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
GOLDENTRONICMIGHTY: Approaching the 100 Metres was shifted to the inside of ZETA HEDGE to continue into clear running.
ZETA HEDGE: H T Mo reported that over the final 200 Metres his saddle shifted back, placing him at a disadvantage.
FLOWING RICHES: C L Chau reported that he was unable to cross runners from his wide barrier and as a result was caught wide in the early stages and was obliged to race further back in the field to ensure it was able to obtain cover behind KA YING RADIANCE.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PRIME ACE: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Approaching the 300 Metres had some difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of SOLID CAR.
INCREDIBLE MOMENT: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
GREEN FIELD PEARL: K C Leung reported that his mount jumped better than expected today and as a result was able to hold an on-pace position.
KA YING RADIANCE: M F Poon reported that his mount was disadvantaged by having to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
STAR FIGURE: Slow to begin.  For a short distance near the 50 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when held up to the inside of ISLAND BUDDY which shifted in.
VOYAGE BUBBLE: C L Chau stated that his mount failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and the only explanation he could offer was that VOYAGE BUBBLE did not appreciate carrying top weight of 135 lbs and being first up today.  Trainer P F Yiu stated that the horse had pleased him leading into the race and concurred with the explanation offered by Jockey Chau.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of VOYAGE BUBBLE was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, VOYAGE BUBBLE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HELIOS EXPRESS: On jumping was bumped by WINNING WING which shifted out.
BEAUTY JOY: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  After passing the winning post was checked when crowded between SKY JEWELLERY (A Badel) and PATCH OF THETA (M F Poon), both of which shifted ground.  Both A Badel and M F Poon were advised to exercise more care.
STORMY GROVE: K C Leung could offer no excuse for his mount’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SKY JEWELLERY: Jumped only fairly.  Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between MY WISH and SOLEIL FIGHTER, both of which shifted ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SAGACIOUS LIFE: Raced keenly in the early stages.  E C W Wong reported that his mount made a respiratory noise during the race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
WINNING WING: Shifted out at the start and was bumped.
INVINCIBLE IBIS: Withdrawn on 15.10.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (left front ligament injury).  Before being allowed to race again, INVINCIBLE IBIS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MR INCREDIBLE: Bumped at the start.  When questioned K Teetan stated that his instructions were to settle the horse where comfortable and if possible obtain a position midfield with cover, particularly under its top weight of 135 lbs.  He said in the early stages when positioned to the outside of MAKE YOU SMILE, MR INCREDIBLE made contact with that runner when MAKE YOU SMILE shifted out slightly.  He said when caught wide to the outside of MAKE YOU SMILE, he contemplated following LA FORZA but when MR INCREDIBLE was not travelling well enough to do so he elected to obtain a trailing position behind MAKE YOU SMILE to save ground and allow the horse to travel where comfortable.  He added after following MAKE YOU SMILE in the middle stages he improved to that runner’s outside on entering the Home Straight where his mount finished the race off well.  Trainer B Crawford confirmed the instructions issued.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SMART GOLF: In the middle stages raced keenly and refused to settle.  H Bentley stated that the instructions were to hold a more forward position but his mount was slow to begin and then did not show sufficient pace in the early stages to go forward.  He added in the Home Straight his mount was disappointing in the manner in which it finished the race off.  Trainer F C Lor confirmed the instructions were to go forward and, in his opinion, SMART GOLF was disadvantaged by settling back in the field.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of SMART GOLF was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, SMART GOLF will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MAKE YOU SMILE: After travelling a short distance L Ferraris was required to reposition his right foot in his stirrup.  Jockey Ferraris was spoken to in relation to this and advised he must ensure that he has his foot properly secured in his stirrup prior to the commencement of every race.
LA FORZA: Bumped at the start.  B Avdulla stated that the instructions were to hold a midfield position.  He said when unable to cross runners to his inside in the early stages LA FORZA was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HAPPY SHOOTER: Between the 350 Metres and the 250 Metres had some difficulty obtaining clear running.
HONEST WITNESS: The tongue tie was refitted at the Start.
SUPER STRONG KID: Was withdrawn at the Start by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice after it was found to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPER STRONG KID will be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments.
PACKING FIGHTER: Near the 350 Metres shifted in and made contact with MASTER LUCKY.  Sent for sampling post-race.
WINDLORD: Reared on jumping and lost ground.
MISTER DAPPER: Shifted in at the start and made contact with PRIME SUCCESS.  B Avdulla reported that his mount did not appreciate the early and middle stages being run inside of standard time.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
COMPLETE UNKNOWN: Shifted in on jumping and was bumped.
SO NAIVE: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
JOYFUL JOY: When questioned J Orman stated that the instructions were to endeavour to be slightly more forward, however, JOYFUL JOY jumped awkwardly and then did not show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.  He said during the event he followed FORTUNE BOY and making the Home Turn he elected to shift to the inside of FORTUNE BOY to improve, particularly as FORTUNE BOY shifted off on the Home Turn.  He said after improving behind SONIC LINER he was unable to identify a run available to the inside and for this reason near the 350 Metres he steadied and shifted his mount out across FORTUNE BOY and PRIME SUCCESS to obtain clear running.  He added after commencing to ride his mount along leaving the 250 Metres JOYFUL JOY then had further difficulty obtaining clear running between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres.  He said after shifting to the outside of SHAMUS STORM, JOYFUL JOY then finished the race off well.  After considering the explanation the Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Orman were reasonable in the circumstances.
SHAMUS STORM: On jumping became unbalanced when bumped by COMPLETE UNKNOWN which shifted in.  Sent for sampling post-race.
NATURAL NUMBERS: Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by PRIME SUCCESS.
MASTER LUCKY: Bumped near the 350 Metres.  A Badel stated that after leading the event and with the race being run inside of standard time his mount failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and may not have run out a strong 1600 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
AMAZING PARTNERS: Withdrawn on 18.10.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (irregular heart rhythm) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter WINDLORD.  Before being allowed to race again, AMAZING PARTNERS will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BEAUTY BOLT: Between the 400 Metres and the 200 Metres was held up for clear running between CHILL BUDDY and AEROINVINCIBLE which shifted out.  After being shifted to the inside of AEROINVINCIBLE after the 200 Metres BEAUTY BOLT then could not be ridden out between the 150 Metres and the 50 Metres when AEROINVINCIBLE shifted back in.
MIGHTY MASTS: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
EMBLAZON: Jumped awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with NYX GLUCK.  K C Leung stated that his mount came under pressure in the Home Straight and when he was concerned there was something amiss he did not ride it out to the finish of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of EMBLAZON, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, EMBLAZON will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GENEVA: J Orman stated that his mount travelled further forward than he had expected.  He said GENEVA was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event and soon after entering the Home Straight came under pressure and gave ground.  Trainer D J Halll could offer no excuse for the horse’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of GENEVA was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, GENEVA will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
CHILL BUDDY: C L Chau reported that his mount responded only fairly to his riding in the Home Straight and, in his opinion, raced flat which he attributed to the horse having two hard runs this season.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
AKASHVANI: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
NYX GLUCK: Bumped at the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
KING OF FIGHTERS: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
SALON S: Was withdrawn prior to the race by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice after it was found to be displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, SALON S will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
